description:
Returns the current value of a single Aletheia indicator by id, with its methodology reference. This server serves the venue-independent indicator set; an indicator anchored on a single venue's own rate is served by that venue's own MCP and answers here with a pointer to it. Call list_indicators first to discover valid ids.

Optionally returns the historical series instead of the current value (set include_history). History is free and unmetered on the same terms as the current value.

This is descriptive data; no recommendation is provided. An indicator that has no reading on this network says so explicitly rather than returning a null or a zero that could be mistaken for a value.

With as_known_on, an indicator kept by vintage (list_indicators marks it as_known_on: true) is returned as it was published at the end of that day (UTC), so a figure quoted then can be reproduced. An indicator recomputed when asked has no past vintage and refuses as_known_on.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-M6, SQ-M7, SQ-C4, SQ-I2, SQ-I3, SQ-I4, SQ-I5, SQ-I6, SQ-I7, SQ-Ch3, SQ-Ch5, SQ-Co2.

as_known_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the indicator as published at the end of that day (UTC). Only for indicators kept by vintage.

from.description: History start, ISO 8601 date. Only meaningful with include_history.

include_history.description: If true, return the historical series instead of the current value. Not every indicator has one.

series.description: With include_history, one series of a measure (its `series[]` names them), e.g. 'cx.class.algorithmic.borrow_spread_over_ust_3m'. Default: the headline series

to.description: History end, ISO 8601 date. Only meaningful with include_history.

wrapper.description: With include_history on wrc, one wrapper's coverage history

name: get_indicator
title: Get an Indicator
